HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   C. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.
   C. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Kalpasutra and Dhammapada and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Specific morning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
